caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, symmetrical arrangement featuring a central oval mirror framed by an intricate, brown and gold decorative border composed of interlocking loops and floral-like motifs. On each side of the mirror is a figurine of a woman with brown hair, facing inward toward the mirror. Each woman wears a multi-layered dress with horizontal stripes of red, gold, and blue. Below the mirror is a pair of stylized, dark brown palm fronds fanning outward. Below the fronds, an arrangement includes a golden obelisk with an eye motif, a small United States flag with red, white, and blue colors, a ribbon, and a shield adorned with the colors red, white, and blue as well as an eagle motif. All of this rests on a carved, symmetrical dark brown base with leaf designs. The background of the image is a plain, off-white or beige color. The artist's signature, "FRANCES Lichten," is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Mirror
